source: specs/063-clean-rebuild-contract/spec.md (product-flow steps and feature ownership) and the "Owned interaction steps" section of each spec 064 to 072

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-01, LIB-FR-02; D18, D-W12
entries.action: Read the Locations step, then add Astro-T7/Captures with the native folder picker and a display name, and add Cold-1/Captures as a second Captures folder.
entries.expect: Captures is marked required and the optional roles are named. Each row shows its path, role, volume kind, access state and Online.
entries.negative: Adding a folder starts no indexing and creates, renames, moves or deletes no file. No processing application, Project, run folder, workspace root or account is requested.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-01, LIB-AC-01
entries.action: Add the Astro-T7/Calibration location and leave Results unset.
entries.expect: Onboarding continues and Results reads not set.
entries.negative: The unset Results role is not shown as an error, a warning or a failed setup.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-03, LIB-FR-04, LIB-FR-05, LIB-FR-06, LIB-FR-07, LIB-FR-09, LIB-FR-12, LIB-AC-02, LIB-AC-03, LIB-AC-04, LIB-AC-05, LIB-AC-06; D01, D11, D15, D-W37
entries.action: Start indexing, inspect the resulting sessions and their association evidence, confirm Targets and the RedCat rig in the catalog, and rescan with an unreadable session folder and then with it restored. Verify the manifest and take Cold-1 offline.
entries.expect: Seven metadata-homogeneous light sessions appear, each frame Unreviewed, with the evidence behind each association. Needs review appears where evidence is missing or conflicts, and confirmations change only the catalog. The unreadable folder reads unknown scope until it is restored.
entries.negative: No session mixes channels and no OBJECT label alone assigns a Target. Source bytes stay byte-identical to the manifest, and unreadable or offline frames never read Missing.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-03, LIB-FR-07, LIB-FR-10, LIB-FR-15, LIB-AC-07, LIB-AC-09, LIB-AC-16; 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-09; D02, D11, D19, D-W7, D-W39
entries.action: Browse Home and Sessions while indexing runs, recover the denied location with Retry, and take Cold-1 offline. Later, review retiring the lost archive location, meet a refusal after it returns, retire it from a fresh review, and register its folder again.
entries.expect: Home opens first with its six sections, and totals are provisional and name their locations. The denied row offers Choose folder again and Retry, and an offline location keeps its last-observed metadata. Retirement review names the location and the sessions, runs, Projects and Results that reference it; retired copies read Retired and stay named unresolved in fixed runs, and the folder registers again as a new location.
entries.negative: No total implies unscanned data, and offline, denied or retired files never read Missing or empty. Retirement changes no file, and no retired decision, association or correction transfers to the re-registered copies.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-08, LIB-FR-10, LIB-AC-05, LIB-AC-09; D18, D-W39
entries.action: From Home, search Targets for NGC 7000 and open its Target page.
entries.expect: Captured, library-wide usable and Unreviewed integration show by channel, with usable at 0h 00m and Unreviewed equal to captured. Availability is a separate state, and the 12 Sep OIII contribution counts in captured with its last-observed values and reads Offline.
entries.negative: The offline contribution is not offered as an available processing input, and search needs no network connection.

entries.spec: 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-01, PRJ-FR-02, PRJ-FR-03, PRJ-FR-04, PRJ-FR-05, PRJ-FR-08, PRJ-FR-09, PRJ-FR-12, PRJ-FR-21, PRJ-AC-01, PRJ-AC-02, PRJ-AC-03, PRJ-AC-09, PRJ-AC-14; D10, D12, D-W30, D-W36, D-W37, D-W66
entries.action: Create Project NGC 7000 HOO from the Target with rig RedCat and the HOO goal template, read its derived candidates and goals, edit a goal and add rig Esprit. Later, lower the Ha goal until it reads met and set it back.
entries.expect: The Project starts with NGC 7000 as its subject and Ha 10h and OIII 10h goals. Candidates are exactly the sessions whose confirmed Target and rig match the Project, and each goal shows in project and captured, where captured counts the candidates plus run members. A met goal leaves the Project open.
entries.negative: Creating or editing the Project changes no file, creates no run and changes no quality state. The Project assigns no session itself, and captured never reads lower than in project.

entries.spec: 072-observing-plans PLAN-FR-01, PLAN-FR-09, PLAN-FR-10, PLAN-AC-01, PLAN-AC-10, PLAN-TGT-AC-14; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-06, PRJ-AC-04; D07, D-W16, D-W62
entries.action: Inspect the candidates' capture sites, then switch the planning site on the Project page and in the Plan area, and open the Planner from the Project.
entries.expect: Each session keeps its own capture site, and windows recalculate and name the chosen planning site and its time zone. Open in Planner limits Targets to the Project's subjects with the rig selector on this Project's rigs.
entries.negative: Project subjects, run sessions and capture sites do not change, and notifications stay disabled.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-01, VSEL-FR-02, VSEL-FR-03, VSEL-AC-01, VSEL-AC-16, VSEL-AC-18; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-10, PRJ-FR-20; D-W1, D-W8, D-W37, D-W50
entries.action: Choose Start a processing run from a Target that is in no Project, then create the Project and the run. From the Project page, start a run on subject NGC 7000 and rig RedCat.
entries.expect: From the Target, PlateVault first asks for Create Project or Add to Project. The run is created inside the Project with only the Project's subject and rig as choices, opens at Select with its candidates preselected, and the stage rail lists it at Select although every goal is unmet.
entries.negative: No standalone or Target-only run is offered. Starting a run creates no folder on disk, changes no quality state and lists no session from another rig.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-01, VSEL-FR-02; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-10; D-W3, D-W8, D-W50, D-W72
entries.action: Move along the run's pipeline rail through Select, Review, Calibrate and Prepare, toggle Sky coverage, and read the run header.
entries.expect: Every step shows the same selection, names what it still needs and offers Move run to Trash. The header shows the run name, Project, subject, rig and profile Not chosen, with the subject and rig fixed.
entries.negative: No wizard gates movement between steps. Moving saves no revision, creates no folder and starts no measurement, and no control moves the run to another Project.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-03, VSEL-AC-01, VSEL-AC-08, VSEL-AC-16, VSEL-AC-18; D01, D-W33, D-W37, D-W49
entries.action: Read the run's candidate list.
entries.expect: Exactly the six sessions with confirmed Target NGC 7000 on rig RedCat are listed, each with its reason, and the five available ones start selected, including the one whose OBJECT reads Cygnus field. Rows show their geometry evidence and sort by footprint overlap, then separation, with unknown position last.
entries.negative: No session from another rig appears. Listing candidates merges no session, rewrites no header and changes no Target.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-04, VSEL-AC-02; D01, D-W33
entries.action: Open the geometry evidence of a session with a footprint, a pointing-only session and a Position unknown session, then clear and check the unknown one.
entries.expect: FOV from confirmed equipment lists its inputs, the pointing-only session shows a distance and no footprint, and Position unknown shows no distance. The unknown session can be checked like any other.
entries.negative: Unknown geometry never shows a distance of 0 or a footprint derived from a Target or OBJECT label, and it removes no candidate.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-05, VSEL-FR-06, VSEL-AC-03, VSEL-AC-18; 067-frame-review PIX-AC-06; D-W37
entries.action: Apply the channel, Missing OBJECT and quality-state filters, open the expanded controls, sort by sky distance, and search.
entries.expect: Filter chips, match counts and the count of selected sessions hidden by filters show. Measurement columns read Not measured.
entries.negative: Filters change no selected session and no session definition, offer no equipment control, show no other-rig session, and start no measurement.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-06, VSEL-FR-07, VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-13, VSEL-FR-16, VSEL-AC-03, VSEL-AC-04; 065-project-goals PRJ-AC-10; D02, D08, D-W34, D-W36, D-W44
entries.action: Show the selection, clear it and restore it with Select matching, browse with sorting, paging and Sky coverage, and save the run. Later, save it again after review exclusions.
entries.expect: Available frames of the five sessions are included (214 lights, 17h 50m) with Unreviewed and library-Unusable counts visible, and the selection survives sorting, paging and the sky toggle. Save run commits a membership revision, and the Project counts those frames in project.
entries.negative: Inclusion applies no quality action, and the run never reads saved before its write succeeds. Saving creates no folder and makes no offline or other-rig session a Project member.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-09, VSEL-AC-09; D02
entries.action: Check the offline 12 Sep session, read its state, then clear its checkbox.
entries.expect: While selected it reads Offline, its last-observed frames are unverified, and the summary names them as unresolved members with reconnect, locate and remove offered. Cleared, it stays listed as an Offline candidate.
entries.negative: An offline session is never dropped silently or counted as verified.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-01, PIX-FR-06, PIX-FR-10, PIX-AC-01, PIX-AC-10; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-09, LIB-AC-14; D19, D-W13
entries.action: Open the Review step, inspect frames while measuring runs, cancel measurement and reopen. Replace a reviewed frame's bytes in place, rescan and reopen review, then restore the reviewed bytes.
entries.expect: Pending frames and progress show, and after Cancel unfinished frames read Not measured. Cached values reappear at once on reopening and the rest resume. The replaced frame reads ChangedContent outside usable totals and is measured again, and restored bytes make it Picked again.
entries.negative: Cancel discards no selection, inclusion or exclusion. Cached values for other bytes never read valid, imported values never read verified, and no quality decision is recorded.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-02, PIX-FR-03, PIX-FR-04, PIX-FR-10, PIX-FR-11, PIX-FR-12, PIX-FR-13, PIX-FR-15, PIX-FR-16, PIX-AC-02, PIX-AC-07, PIX-AC-14, PIX-AC-15, PIX-AC-17; D03, D-W13, D-W14, D-W15, D-W22, D-W40
entries.action: Select frames from a row and a plot point, zoom, pan, compare and step frames, apply and remove a stretch, switch views and table heights, change the frame-name template, and select by threshold.
entries.expect: The selected frame is highlighted in every view, the plots and the preview, and the disclosure shows metadata, source and units. Measured values are identical with the stretch on and off, and threshold selection picks exactly the measured frames past the value.
entries.negative: Stretching, thumbnails and the name template change no measured value, source byte or file name. Threshold selection changes no quality state or membership.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-05, PIX-FR-06, PIX-AC-03
entries.action: Enable Stars and inspect a fitted star and a saturated star.
entries.expect: Fit details and cutouts show, with distinct HFR and FWHM labels and units. The saturated star reads failed fit with a saturation warning.
entries.negative: No FWHM or other fitted-width number is shown for a failed fit.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-10, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-AC-04; D02, D-W3, D-W44
entries.action: Exclude six 30 Sep frames from the run, restore and re-exclude one, read the totals and save.
entries.expect: The 30 Sep row reads 42 of 48, and the run reads 208 lights / 17h 20m (Ha 111 / 9h 15m, OIII 97 / 8h 05m) as saved membership revision 2. The Project's in-project values follow the saved revision.
entries.negative: The files stay on disk. Library quality, Target usable totals, the Project's other runs and its rejection records are unchanged.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-11, VSEL-FR-15, VSEL-AC-05, VSEL-AC-11, VSEL-AC-23; 067-frame-review PIX-FR-13, PIX-FR-14, PIX-AC-12, PIX-AC-16; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-08; 065-project-goals PRJ-AC-08; D10, D-W42, D-W44, D-W54
entries.action: Mark the included frames usable with the named scope, reject and re-pick a frame with hotkeys, reject a frame for this Project only and clear it, and mark the excluded frames in the grid.
entries.expect: The bulk confirmation names library scope, and Target usable integration rises by the marked total. A library reject leaves the draft at once with the reason Rejected, and a Project-only reject lowers only this Project's in-project value.
entries.negative: Hotkey marks ask for no confirmation and change no saved membership revision. A Project-only reject changes no library total.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-06, PIX-FR-07, PIX-FR-08, PIX-AC-04, PIX-AC-05, PIX-AC-11; D03, D19
entries.action: Import a SubframeSelector CSV after one measured frame changes in place, confirm the mapping, and inspect the unresolved rows.
entries.expect: Matched, unmatched and ambiguous rows are listed, and the changed frame's row is listed for review against its recorded digest. Imported values show with provenance next to native values and read content unverified.
entries.negative: No native value is replaced, no imported value attaches to the changed frame or reads verified, and no exclusion or quality change is imported. A column without units is never labeled FWHM or HFR.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-01, CAL-FR-02, CAL-FR-03, CAL-FR-04, CAL-FR-09, CAL-FR-10, CAL-AC-01, CAL-AC-11, CAL-AC-14; D13, D-W5, D-W37, D-W55
entries.action: Move the run to Calibrate, open Review matches, read Why this match for an automatic flat, and inspect the raw flat handoff. In a second run, turn automatic assignment off and accept a suggestion.
entries.expect: Every fully compatible match is assigned automatically and the readiness line reads every group matched. Review matches lists each light group and calibration type as Automatic with its compatible, incompatible and unknown criteria, and raw flats go to the application to build its own masters. With automatic assignment off, matches read Suggested until accepted, then Accepted.
entries.negative: No match with an unknown or incompatible criterion is assigned automatically, and another camera's inputs are never candidates. No temperature tolerance is applied unless shown, no suggestion is a handoff input before acceptance, and no master is written.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-03, CAL-FR-05, CAL-FR-08, CAL-FR-09, CAL-AC-02, CAL-AC-03, CAL-AC-06; 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-03; D-W3, D-W5, D-W49, D-W50
entries.action: In Review matches, replace 24 Sep's automatic 30 Sep flat with the 26 Sep set, record a scoped exception with a reason, then check a second run in the same Project.
entries.expect: The 26 Sep set shows its optical-train state as unknown, 24 Sep reads Needs review and preparation review lists it as unresolved with its choices. After the exception the row reads Excepted with the criterion and the reason. The second run shows no exception and assigns the 30 Sep set automatically.
entries.negative: The flat set's evidence is unchanged and the exception makes it compatible nowhere else. The unresolved flat is not counted as a handoff input, and the 30 Sep set is not reassigned while the user's replacement stands.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-01, PREP-FR-02, PREP-FR-04, PREP-AC-07, PREP-AC-11; D04
entries.action: Choose the Siril profile and locate its executable; in a second run, choose Open in... instead.
entries.expect: The profile shows its capability evidence for input, layout, configuration, product-input kinds and input-write behavior, and names unsupported configuration. Open in... asks for an executable and arguments, reads as not a verified profile, blocks Linked View and Direct source, and offers isolated Copy or supported Clone.
entries.negative: No capability is claimed as verified without evidence, no profile claims that renaming files overrides headers, and nothing is launched.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-03, PREP-AC-06; D15
entries.action: Compare the catalog and header focal length for 28 Sep, accept the source-header value in the main run, and choose isolated patched copies in the check run.
entries.expect: The review names the value the application will read and the effective handoff value. Only the isolated copies carry the patched value.
entries.negative: No correction is claimed as delivered while the tool reads the original value. Originals and links are never patched and stay byte-identical.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-04, PREP-FR-05, PREP-AC-04, PREP-AC-08; D04
entries.action: Read the input modes, try Direct source, then return to Linked View and confirm a hardlink choice.
entries.expect: Each mode states its semantics and storage, and Linked View is suggested. Direct source passes exact paths, or refuses a whole-folder handoff that holds excluded frames and offers supported alternatives. The hardlink confirmation names its volume, permission and filesystem limits.
entries.negative: No overinclusive handoff is accepted, and the link type does not change without explicit confirmation.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-06, PREP-AC-01, PREP-AC-02, PREP-AC-09; D-W3, D-W51
entries.action: Choose a parent where the run folder already exists, lose the chosen parent, then choose Work/Processing. Later, read a new run's suggested location.
entries.expect: The existing folder and the unavailable parent each prompt another choice. The run folder is named from the Project and the run under the chosen parent, and the next run's suggestion uses the last chosen parent.
entries.negative: The existing folder and its content are not reused or cleared, and no other drive or parent is substituted silently.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-07, PREP-AC-01, PREP-AC-21; D-W51, D-W67
entries.action: Read the Results folder of the main run, override the Results parent in the check run, and prepare a second revision.
entries.expect: Results go to the sibling Run Results folder outside the run folder, and an override parent gets the run's Results folder under it. Both prepared revisions share the one Results folder, which is recorded for Result discovery.
entries.negative: The Results folder is never inside the run folder, and the override parent itself is not used as the Results folder.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-04, PREP-FR-08, PREP-AC-01, PREP-AC-03, PREP-AC-13; 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-08; D02, D-W5, D-W9
entries.action: Open Review preparation and confirm the exact membership, then in the check run meet a destination that cannot link.
entries.expect: The review shows the Project, subject, selection, profile, source references, calibration assignments and exception, excluded count, paths, mode, operation count, footprint and free space, with each check read. Where linking is unavailable, Clone, Copy and Direct source are offered with their footprints.
entries.negative: Nothing is written before Prepare, no unknown or omitted input counts as prepared, and no Suggested or Needs review calibration is handed off. A link plan never becomes a copy silently.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-09, PREP-FR-11, PREP-AC-05, PREP-AC-12, PREP-AC-14, PREP-AC-21; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-07, RES-AC-07; D09, D-W51, D-W67
entries.action: Prepare the run, prepare the check run with three blocked inputs while trying Mark processing complete, Retry while one source changes after its snapshot, restore it and Retry, then prepare a second revision.
entries.expect: Prepared appears only when every entry matches the membership and its source snapshot. The partial outcome reads 53 prepared and 3 blocked, then 55 and 1 with drift named, and Retry ends at 56. The second revision lands in a new rev 2 folder beside the first.
entries.negative: An acknowledgment is not success and no verified Open is offered on Partial. Complete is refused for this run while its preparation runs and an unrelated run is not blocked. A drifted item never reads Prepared, and no existing folder is reused or cleared.

entries.spec: 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-10, PREP-AC-10, PREP-AC-15; D19
entries.action: Open with a missing executable, open after a linked input changed in place, then restore it, open Siril and quit it.
entries.expect: Choose application and Reveal run folder are offered. A changed entry refuses the launch and is named against its preparation snapshot. Open re-verifies every entry before launching, and the launch is recorded separately from processing.
entries.negative: The run stays Prepared, Siril never launches on changed bytes, and quitting Siril does not mark the run Complete.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-FR-13, VSEL-FR-14, VSEL-FR-16, VSEL-FR-17, VSEL-AC-06, VSEL-AC-12, VSEL-AC-15, VSEL-AC-20, VSEL-AC-24; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-06, LIB-FR-08, LIB-AC-15; 065-project-goals PRJ-AC-26; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-11; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-07, RES-AC-08; D02, D08, D09, D16, D19, D-W34, D-W45, D-W66
entries.action: Index two new sessions, one also copied to a second Captures location, make a member unreadable and re-confirm another member's Target. Mark the run Complete, meet and decline Reopen, then Reopen, keep the run unchanged, accept one addition, decline the rest and save. Finally change one copy of a copied frame and rescan.
entries.expect: The run offers Add 2 new sessions, the copied frames count once naming both copies, and a Complete run asks for Reopen first. The refresh diff lists additions with reasons, the unreadable member as Unavailable and the re-confirmed member as no longer matching its subject, with exclusions kept. Save run commits revision 3, which survives restart and needs its own review before preparation, and the changed copy reads as conflicting copies.
entries.negative: Membership never changes without approval, and no member leaves without an explicit removal. The prepared revision and the inputs Siril reads stay identical, and no frame is counted twice.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-01, RES-AC-01, RES-AC-16; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-07; D-W4, D-W51, D-W67
entries.action: Open the run's Results step, then open it again after a second prepared revision wrote to the same Results folder.
entries.expect: Candidates come from the run's Results folder, each with type, path, availability, processing state where known, and the prepared revision it came from. A growing file reads Pending, and recognized intermediates are listed apart.
entries.negative: Nothing is auto-accepted or claimed to come from the full selection, and nothing inside the run folder is discovered.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-02, RES-FR-03, RES-AC-02; D-W4
entries.action: Click Attach Result on the Results step and attach a TIFF saved elsewhere as a Final image; later attach another image to the Complete run.
entries.expect: Attach Result is shown on the step beside the discovered list. The file is listed as attached, its run association reads User-linked and its input-frame lineage reads Unknown.
entries.negative: The lineage is never shown as Tool-recorded without tool evidence, and attaching does not reopen a Complete run.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-04, RES-AC-03, RES-AC-10; D19
entries.action: Inspect three products, change one in place before accepting, then inspect it again and accept it.
entries.expect: The accepted products appear on the run, the Project and the Target, read protected Keep, and show the SHA-256 recorded at acceptance. A product changed since inspection is refused until inspected again.
entries.negative: Acceptance upgrades no lineage, claims no use of all planned frames, and never records bytes that were not inspected.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-04, RES-FR-05, RES-AC-04, RES-AC-05, RES-AC-09, RES-AC-13, RES-AC-14; D04, D-W4, D-W8, D-W56
entries.action: Create a run in the Project from accepted Results through its input filters, read another Project's product from another rig, choose a profile, prepare and open the product run, then change an accepted product in place with its size and mtime preserved and restore it.
entries.expect: The picker groups products by originating Project and run with kind, subject, rig, path, availability and lineage. The run lists two product inputs apart from raw sessions, and an unsupported product kind is refused by name. The rehash flags the changed product as drifted and the picker stops offering it until the bytes are restored.
entries.negative: No raw integration is added and the Project gains no members. Nothing is converted, combined or replaced silently, equal size and mtime never stand in for content, and a drifted product is not offered or re-accepted.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-06, CAL-FR-07, CAL-FR-08, CAL-AC-04, CAL-AC-05, CAL-AC-07, CAL-AC-08, CAL-AC-09, CAL-AC-10, CAL-AC-12; 070-results-reuse RES-FR-01, RES-AC-15; D05, D19, D-W5, D-W55
entries.action: Meet the once-only Add to calibration library offer in the run's Results step and dismiss it, then adopt the master from Calibration. Meet an occupied destination path and source changes after review and before registration, adopt into a durable calibration destination, then change and restore the adopted copy.
entries.expect: The offer appears once in the Results step and does not return after Dismiss, while Calibration still lists the candidate. The occupied path is refused and both source changes block adoption with drift named. The master registers with its provenance only after its copy and source match the reviewed digest; a changed adopted copy reads drifted until its bytes are restored.
entries.negative: A detected master is never assigned or suggested before adoption. No existing file is overwritten, no unregistered copy is offered for reuse, the generated source stays in the Results folder, and a drifted master is not assigned, accepted or re-adopted.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-06, RES-FR-07, RES-AC-06, RES-AC-07, RES-AC-08; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-20; 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-17, VSEL-AC-20; D09, D-W26, D-W34
entries.action: Mark processing complete on a run without a Result and on the main run, try edits on a Complete run, meet Add N new sessions on a Complete run, and Reopen a Complete run. Separately, try Mark processing complete while the run's preparation is running.
entries.expect: Complete is recorded with or without a Result, and Clean up is offered as a separate action. Membership edits and Add N new sessions ask for an explicit Reopen first, while notes and Result acceptance go through. After Reopen the run is open with its decisions unchanged.
entries.negative: Completion removes nothing and claims no external success. Complete is refused only while an app-owned preparation or storage mutation affecting this run is running, and notes, Result acceptance, reviewed cleanup and reference repair do not reopen it.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-01, STO-FR-03, STO-AC-01, STO-AC-20; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-14, PREP-AC-19; D-W26, D-W43
entries.action: Open Clean up on a Complete run.
entries.expect: Only the entries the run's preparation revisions created are listed, here one Prepared hardlinks group with count, size, proposed action and Inspect files. The group starts selected.
entries.negative: Nothing in the Results folder is listed, no original capture or library frame is a candidate, the selection never covers the whole run directory, and Clean up offers no move of rejected frames.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-02; D-W3
entries.action: Click Inspect files and deselect one prepared entry.
entries.expect: Each entry shows its path, role, other run or Project references, retained-original evidence and estimated bytes, and the group count drops by one.
entries.negative: Link sizes are not presented as guaranteed reclaimed bytes.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-04, STO-AC-04, STO-AC-08; D19
entries.action: Click Review cleanup on the hardlink run, on a copy run on a location without Trash, and on a symlink run.
entries.expect: The review lists exactly the selected and retained entries with Send to OS Trash, and Trash support per location with movable and blocked counts. A last-copy hardlink is blocked for insufficient retained-original proof, and each symlink shows its identity and target path.
entries.negative: No entry with stale identity, drift, missing proof, an unavailable source or ambiguous ownership is approved. No symlink target or target directory is followed.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-04, STO-FR-05, STO-AC-03, STO-AC-08, STO-AC-09, STO-AC-15; D09, D19
entries.action: Send the selected entries to the Trash after one retained original changes, put one entry back from the OS Trash, try a location without safe Trash, and remove symlink entries.
entries.expect: Per-item outcomes and an exact partial summary name each blocked entry, the run records removed and remaining entries, and removed entries are newly in the OS Trash. The location without Trash refuses its items and offers Keep files and Reveal location.
entries.negative: Link targets are not followed, changed and protected files stay in place, reviewed cleanup does not reopen the run, and no permanent-delete fallback exists.

entries.flowStep: Move run to Trash, Restore and Empty Trash
entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-05, RES-FR-07, RES-FR-10, RES-AC-19, RES-AC-20, RES-AC-21, RES-AC-22; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-04, PRJ-FR-14, PRJ-FR-20, PRJ-AC-29; 071-storage-custody STO-FR-17, STO-AC-24; D-W66, D-W72
entries.action: Try Move run to Trash while the run's preparation is running and while another run uses the run's accepted Results. Move a Complete run on a location without OS Trash to the Project's Trash, read the Project's goals, Restore it, move it again and empty it from the Trash with its Results folder ticked. Move an open run to Trash from the Mark Done prompt and empty it from the Done / Archive sheet.
entries.expect: Move run to Trash is refused while an app-owned preparation affecting the run is running, naming it, as Mark processing complete is, and while another run uses one of its accepted Results, naming each such run. Otherwise the run leaves the stage rail, Home and every picker and shows only in the Project's Trash list, and its members stop counting in project and captured unless they are still candidates. Restore brings it back with its membership revisions, preparation revisions, Results and stage. Empty Trash reviews the run record, its prepared folders and its Results folder, which goes only when ticked. After confirming, the files go to the OS Trash, and anything that cannot go there is named and left in place.
entries.negative: Moving a run to Trash and restoring it move no file. Nothing touches library frames or quality decisions or deletes permanently, a refused Move run to Trash changes nothing, and after Empty Trash the run cannot be restored.
